context: A shot list for the demo-app fixture (a quota settings form with a redacted API key): type a limit, click Save, wait for the saved message, zoom on it, press Meta+K. A second shot list records the same page as an iPhone 15 (touch). Playwright with Chromium and ffmpeg with libx264 are installed.
expected_behavior: check exits 0 for the well-formed shot list and reports the capture as 2560x1440 device pixels (1280x720 at scale 2)
A step with two actions, a target with two kinds, a relative start url, an odd output size, or no visible step exits 2 and names the rule
A zoom deeper than the capture keeps sharp (under 0.8 captured pixels per output pixel) warns with the scale that would fix it; a capture smaller than the frame warns that it will look soft
record writes demo.mp4 (1920x1080, 60 fps), poster.png and manifest.json, and removes its work directory
The desktop manifest records cursor moves, clicks, one key chip, at least one zoom of 1.15x or more, and the mark as a chapter; its duration matches the video
The mobile recording is 1080x1920, captured at scale 3, with touch indicators and no cursor moves or clicks
A step whose target never appears exits 4, names the step, saves failed-step-N.png, prints the page's accessibility snapshot without redacted text, and removes the work directory
failure_modes: Recording CSS pixels: a 2x viewport captured at half resolution
A cursor that teleports, or a click with no visible press
Showing a mouse cursor on a touch device
A redacted secret leaking through the failure snapshot
Leaving raw frames behind in the output directory
